top_signals.title: Dubai’s DIP Eyes Up to $543 Million in First UAE Listing of 2026
top_signals.summary: DIP Holding Plc is seeking to raise as much as $543 million from the first initial public offering in the United Arab Emirates since the Iran war began, a deal that will test investor appetite for Gulf listings.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
